subject: 镖局 / 护运行
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Build ONE realistic Southern Song Lin'an private caravan escort depot compound (镖局原创扩展) on the EXACT quadrilateral ground plane in reference. Retain the exact contour: canvas1536x1024, LEFT(150,540), FRONT(738,834), RIGHT(1200,603), BACK(612,309). Ground footprint14 by11, front LEFT-FRONT edge horizontal588, adjacent FRONT-RIGHT edge462, ratio1.2727. Their slopes exactly+.5/-.5. This is exact orthographic2:1 isometric no perspective; all ground/wall/roof axes parallel to these two guide edges. Realistic muted brown timber, handmade grey tiled roofs, cream plaster perimeter wall with stone footing. One low rear office hall, smaller side store, a broad enclosed tamped earth court with one wood cart and tied cargo crates. Plain wide gateway centered on LEFT-FRONT wall. Clear unobstructed outer two base edges and sharp front corner, ground is thin, no thick model pedestal. Complete eaves within canvas. Upper-left warm daylight, short down-right shadow. Remove white background and black outline and corner labels entirely; actual transparent alpha background. No people, no logos, no writing, no modern objects, no Qing/Ming palace style. Ground four corners must follow reference even if architecture layout must adapt. Keep reference positions, don't auto-fit or rotate ground.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

references.role: geometry guide：自制占地轮廓QA图，非生成资产

created_time_basis: 生成后记录的接收/归档时间；非工具披露的服务端调用时间

steps: uniform LANCZOS resize; dimensions rounded to nearest px
paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding

geometry_qa.precision_note: 人工读可见底面边；±3px不确定性；非3D测绘，隐藏后角未直接测得。

notes: 第2次运行返修：内置image_gen真实重出主体；逐张view_image及64×32占地叠图，宽深关系和两轴目视协调，左上光、暖灰瓦木石、宋意象，无文字人物现代物；无裁切。严格几何数值见geometry_qa；不将轻微告警当成已通过。
